question:
For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to PLT <= 100 or PLT >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to PLT < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(PLT < 100), SUM(PLT > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to PLT > 400;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_020 < XCL_021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
  SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_020 > XCL_022 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM Laboratory
WHERE XCL_020 < XCL_021 OR XCL_020 > XCL_022

operator_plan: Filter rows where Laboratory.XCL_034 <= 100 OR Laboratory.XCL_034 >= 400
Compute SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.XCL_034 < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Subtract the second sum from the first sum
